claim_en: THE MURMURERS; 'THE PEOPLE' ARE THE WICKED; THE FIRE SANK IN ITS PLACE; NAMES BY THE EVENT. 'And the people were as murmurers' (the word's one seat — computed) — seekers of a pretext (2 Kgs 5:7; Judg 14:4) or blows or self-affliction or idolatry (four readings); 'THE PEOPLE' everywhere the wicked, 'MY PEOPLE' the upright — a lexical rule with proof-seats (Exod 17:4; Num 14:11; Jer 13:10 / Exod 7:16; Mic 6:3); 'in the ears of the LORD' — they meant Him to hear (Onkelos 'before the LORD'); 'the fire of the LORD' (11:1, 11:3 and Elijah's 1 Kgs 18:38) at the edge of the camp (Gideon's phrase) — the proselytes or the officers; 'the people cried to Moses' — the intercessor; 'the fire SANK' (the verb's one Torah seat) — in its place, not to heaven nor sideways; TABERAH named FOR THE EVENT, not before — as Massah-Meribah and the graves of lust: a naming rule read off 'because' (Onkelos renders the name: 'burning').

claim_en: THE SPEAKER SPLIT — ONE VERSE, TWO SPEAKERS, SEVEN PARALLELS. 'Only to the manna are our eyes' (11:6) is ISRAEL'S; 'and the manna was like coriander seed, like bdellium' (11:7) is GOD'S ANSWER to the generations — the Sifrei assigns adjacent clauses to two voices, with parallels: Gen 38:25-26 (Judah / Scripture), Deut 25:18 (Israel faint / Amalek unfearing), Judg 5:28-31 (Sisera's mother / her ladies / Deborah), 1 Sam 4:8 (the righteous / the wicked), Jer 26:16-24, Ruth 3:13 (Boaz to his inclination / to Ruth): a teacher's attribution rule the catalog did not hold — REGISTERED as M-27 THE SPEAKER SPLIT (MOVE_CATALOG.md); the manna never expelled (Ps 78:25); the ink: 'coriander seed' at Exod 16:31 and here, 'bdellium' at Gen 2:12 and here (computed).
middah: M-27 (the speaker split — the clauses of one verse assigned to two voices by the teacher's recorded rule)
